summary: Iteration 105: Learned Memory CRUD + @ai remember + Role Freshness + M365 Teams scope tested end-to-end on WEB and MOBILE. Backend: 13/13 pytest passing (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration105_memory_freshness_m365.py, iteration105.xml). Web: /ai-memory page renders memory-page, memory-personal/workspace, memory-add-input-* / memory-add-btn-*, memory-toggle-{id}, memory-forget-{id}; add + toggle + forget round-trips work; sidebar nav-ai-memory routes correctly; Role Intelligence Roles tab = 2 freshness-pill + 1 freshness-none (Sales Director = No knowledge yet, Finance Manager = Updated today, Restaurant Ops Mgr = Updated 5d ago); Risk tab same. Mobile: You tab → you-memory → /memory renders mem-add-input-{personal,workspace} + mem-add-btn-{personal,workspace} + mem-toggle/mem-forget; add + toggle + forget round-trips work (items 4 → 3 after forget). MOBILE freshness testIDs were MISSING originally (visual pill rendered but no testID) — added testID='freshness-pill'/'freshness-none' to /app/mobile/src/components/enterprise/ui.tsx Freshness component; after mobile restart Roles/Risk tabs now expose 2 pill + 1 none each, achieving parity with web. Backend endpoints exercised: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/memory/learned (dedupe by normalized text confirmed, unknown-id → 404, empty text → 400), @ai remember flow via POST /api/chats/{id}/messages posts an ai_answer with metadata.memory_saved=true AND creates the personal memory (verified via GET /api/memory/learned), normal @ai question still returns a full research answer, GET /api/enterprise/roles + /api/enterprise/risk-dashboard include per-role freshness map, GET /api/oauth/m365/login authorization URL scope contains User.Read + Mail.Read + Chat.Read + offline_access. NOTE: Connectors M365/Gmail train-modal source selector could not be exercised live (no OAuth-connected M365/Gmail accounts in this workspace), but code inspection of /app/frontend/src/pages/ConnectorsPage.jsx confirms {base==='m365' && <select data-testid='train-source'>} guards the selector to M365 only — Gmail modal correctly omits it.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/services/learned_memory.py extract_and_store() is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task in ai_runtime.py — the task reference is not stored, so under short-lived workers Python may GC it before completion (same pattern flagged in iter 104 for enterprise autocapture). Consider a background-task registry or FastAPI BackgroundTasks. Reference: /app/backend/services/ai_runtime.py:401-402.

backend/services/learned_memory.py remember() dedupe key is scope+workspace+(user_id for personal)+norm_key. Norm_key truncates to 200 chars, so two memories with identical first 200 chars but different suffixes will collide. Low risk for durable facts but worth documenting. Reference: /app/backend/services/learned_memory.py:37-38, 71-72.

backend/routes/learned_memory.py PATCH /learned/{id} does NOT accept an empty body — payload.text=None + payload.active=None still returns 200 without changing anything. Consider raising 400 if both are None. Reference: /app/backend/routes/learned_memory.py:39-43.

backend/services/ai_runtime.py handle_ai_command manual-remember branch (lines 234-250) does not deduct credits and does not go through the AI-billing gate — intended for a no-model path, but confirm the /messages endpoint's rate limiter still applies so users cannot spam '@ai remember'.

backend/services/m365_connector.py fetch_teams_messages() paginates only $top=20 chats and $top=20 msgs each — no nextLink follow — so on a large tenant Teams samples may be sparse. Fine for style-learning but call out in docs.
